name: web3_career-jobs-mcp
description: Web3 Career (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_web3_career_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_WEB3_CAREER_TOKEN
platform_mcp_web3_career_token.description: Web3.career API token from https://web3.career/web3-jobs-api ('Your token is for your use only … Do not share it').

tools.name: search
tools.description: GET /api/v1?token=&tag=&limit= (1–100, no offset or cursor, so page is ignored). tag must be one exact slug from the documented list (solidity, rust, backend, defi, …) — 'Invalid tags silently return empty results' — so pass a tag as query. The body is a mixed array '[string, string, Job[]]' ('typically at index 2'), mapped from element 2. country wants a slug (united-states), not ISO, and remote only accepts 'true', so neither is sent. url is apply_url (required attribution link); salary is free text (raw).
